column3: Sets the two-divorce limit and its boundaries; 2:230 gives the consequence after a further divorce.
Establishes faith-based eligibility for marriage, relevant to the new marriage named in 2:230.
Shows that marriage has prohibited categories, but adds no rule about divorce and return.
